account:
It is day 0, ten in the morning, and I have reached the plaza for my scheduled market walk. So far the town seems to be going about ordinary business. Several townsfolk were gathered outside town hall, and others are gathered here in the plaza. Townsfolk 08 and 30 told me they had no news. Townsfolk 18 and 28 both reported that the baker had been carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery. That sounds consistent with obtaining ingredients for bread, but I have not seen it myself and have no evidence of anything unusual behind it. I saw the builder walking near the market carrying a lantern; I do not know their destination or purpose.

The secretary said no correspondence or town news had reached them and planned to check with the people outside before my market walk. There was a brief confusion about the appointment book: I had returned it to its chest, and then saw the secretary take it. The secretary subsequently confirmed having it and promised to keep it safe. They are now approaching the plaza. I asked which dockside cottage hosts my afternoon tea, but have not received an answer. My remaining appointments today are lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at one, dockside tea at three, office at four thirty, and home at seven. Nothing I have learned yet establishes a disturbance or any concealed purpose.
